Additionally define `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-error`, `--border-success` for feedback states. * **Contrast pairing:** every light background token pairs with `--color-text` (#111111); dark surfaces pair with light text (#fefefe — never `#ffffff` for text on dark). * **Radius:** `--radius-sm: 2px; --radius-md: 4px; --radius-lg: 8px; --radius-pill: 999px`. * **Shadows:** `--shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)`; define `--shadow-md` as a subtle elevation. * **Spacing:** `--space-1: 8px` through `--space-24: 192px` (8/16/24/32/48/64/96/128/192). * **Typography:** `--text-xs` through `--text-5xl` (0.75rem → 4rem); `--font-sans` and `--font-display` both bound to Inter. * **Transitions:** `--transition-fast: 120ms`, `--transition-normal: 240ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`. * **Hairline:** `--hairline: 1px solid #e6e6e6` — the signature minimal border. * **Stacking:** `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`. **1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode** * Define dark tokens under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` **and** a `.dark` class on ``: `--color-bg: #111111`, `--color-surface: #161616`, `--color-surface-2: #1c1c1c`, `--color-text: #fefefe`, `--color-text-muted: #9a9a9a`, `--color-primary: #fefefe`, `--color-accent: #fefefe`, `--color-border: #2a2a2a`. * Include a visible theme toggle button (Google Material Symbols icon: `dark_mode`/`light_mode`) in the nav with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label`. * Persist choice via `localStorage`; fall back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit.
